initial_metadata_failure.resolution: Bounded metadata-only inventory verified literal source name and ID; subsequent query uses exact source ID, preserves source spelling and requires exact retained identity. No flood reductions ran in the failed checkpoint.

observation_cautions: All three band masks and clear_views>0 required; permanent water excluded.
Zero-water status requires complete computation and valid fraction >=95%, not an independently verified non-flood label.
DFO metadata and image footprints can span multiple regions/countries; a footprint is not actual floodwater.
All IFI associations remain provisional; no causal event identity or exact flood day is established.
Modern public district geometries are not verified historical/current-LGD identities.
Raw clear_views and clear_perc values are not rescaled or represented as verified day/percentage normalization.

publication_scope: Only reviewed code/tests, source identifiers, aggregate summaries/rankings and provenance/checksums published. SOI geometry and rainfall tables, detailed candidate/event records, raw journals and exact public geometry retained locally. No satellite raster exports.
quality_semantics: Raw source clear_views/clear_perc/duration sums and means; no guessed days/percentage normalization; event-window extent not daily occurrence.

readiness.next_task: Stage 3C: separately authorized, targeted exploratory historical rainfall windows for positive satellite evidence, preserving event-window uncertainty and prediction-time availability; no training or daily/negative labels.
reasons: Only four positive maps across three public regions and three years; one positive is only two cells.
Seven insufficient-observation results and regional/temporal/selection bias remain.
Two observed-zero maps are not independent negative training observations.
Maximum event extent has no exact daily timing; all IFI spatial associations remain provisional.
readiness.stage3c: Limited exploratory rainfall-window construction for the four verified positive event/region scopes is supported; first explicitly anchor dates and retain separate IFI/GFD windows.

selection_rule: Exclude prior IDs, ambiguous IFI links, weak/invalid/out-of-period windows, non-Karnataka-only IFI, and non-India-primary DFO metadata. Require a unique exact original district token, public Karnataka state containment >=99%, positive event-footprint intersection and safe existing planner. All remaining candidates are strong temporal and non-ambiguous; greedily prefer new years, new regions, higher IFI overlap fraction/Jaccard, smaller region, fewer source tokens, then stable IDs. Seed diversity from prior seven reviews; one region per GFD ID, up to ten. No raster outcomes used. Footprint intersections permit research review only, not verified IFI event identity or floodwater.

timing.accepted_budget: 60-second per attempt; 900-second suspend-inclusive total; three attempts maximum and 2/4-second backoff
